entities.summary: Wael Al-Aydy is an Egyptian indoor volleyball player, who played with the Egypt national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics. He plays as a libero. He was part of the Egypt men's national volleyball team at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Italy. He played for ZAMALEK in 2010.
